Disconnect broken P2P and HTTP connections promptly on socket exceptions
Prevent doomed send attempts and unrequested reads when socket reading is paused
agreement: Support because it fixes socket loop issues in P2P (darosior)
Approach support because removing select exception sets prevents urgent data loops (midnightmagic)
Prefers failing on errors across all platforms rather than Windows-specific handling (darosior, theuni)
Open question on the rationale for the second commit (darosior)
